# Synthetic escrow accounting inputs

These small compressed NBT inputs are generated by
`EscrowAccountingOracleFixtureTest` using the real saved codecs. They are unit-test
fixtures, not native persistence or activation evidence.

With Java 17, run `gradlew.bat --offline test --tests '*EscrowAccountingOracleFixtureTest'`.
The generated copies are in `build/w365-fixtures`. Root-2 records and released
receipts deliberately retain their legacy versions. Root-3 inputs cover planned,
O1, O3 and O4 states for fuel and cargo, with KNOWN and missing-endpoint UNKNOWN
accounts. `worst-row.nbt` is the real codec's 14-member maximum-layout row.
